exposure: Bupivacaine alone for combined spinal and epidural anaesthesia
Hydromorphone hydrochloride combined with bupivacaine for combined spinal and epidural anaesthesia
outcome: Time to first voiding after anaesthesia
cohort: 105 women who underwent caesarean section (51 receiving bupivacaine alone and 54 receiving hydromorphone hydrochloride combined with bupivacaine)
finding: The addition of hydromorphone hydrochloride to bupivacaine for combined spinal and epidural anaesthesia was associated with a reduced incidence of postpartum urinary retention and improved postoperative voiding parameters.
